data_export_email_body1: Du bad om en kopia av dina data, och den är bifogad i det här mejlet som en JSON-fil.
data_export_email_body2: Den innehåller det du delat med Rumi och det vi sparar om dig: din profil, dina minnen, dina åtaganden, dina sessioner och dina minuter.
data_export_email_body3: Spara filen på ett säkert ställe — den som öppnar den kan läsa den. Om det inte var du som bad om detta, svara på det här mejlet.
verification_email_instruction: Use this code to confirm your email address:
verification_email_expiry: This code is valid for 15 minutes.
verification_email_ignore: If you didn't request this code, you can safely ignore this email.
footer_text: Helping you reach your full potential.
verification_sms_content: Your rumi.coach validation code is: {{.code}}. Valid for 15 minutes.
waitlist_joined_email_body1: Welcome, and thank you for joining the Rumi waitlist.
waitlist_joined_email_body2: Here's what happens next: the app goes live in a few weeks, and we'll invite people from this list first, in batches. When your spot is ready, you'll get an email from me, and your first session is free.
waitlist_joined_email_body3: In the meantime, I have one question for you: what would you talk through first? Just hit reply, I read every answer, and it genuinely shapes what we build.
account_activated_email_body2: Rumi är en coach du pratar med. Den lyssnar, ställer de rätta frågorna och medan du pratar anpassar sig din skärm efter samtalet. Allt är privat: ditt samtal raderas när sessionen avslutas.
account_activated_email_body3: Din första session är gratis. Hitta en lugn plats, ta på dig hörlurar och ge det 10 minuter. Prata om vad du än har på hjärtat, eller välj ett område i ditt liv som du vill förbättra.
account_activated_email_body4: Om något känns fel eller förvirrande är det bara att svara på detta mejl och berätta. Jag läser varje svar, och det är exakt den feedback vi behöver just nu.
welcome_email_body1: Welcome to rumi.coach! We're thrilled to have you.
welcome_email_body2: Let's get started on your journey to reaching your full potential.
account_activated_sms: Great news {{.name}}! Your rumi.coach account is now active. Log in to get started.
waitlist_joined_sms: Hi {{.name}}, you're on the rumi.coach waitlist! We'll text you when you're in.
welcome_sms: Welcome to rumi.coach {{.name}}! Log in to get started.
recommendations_email_body1: Here are some personalized recommendations based on your goals:
lead_confirmation_body1: Thank you for getting in touch with us about Rumi for Business. We have received your request and our team will contact you shortly.
lead_confirmation_body2: If you have any immediate questions, feel free to reply directly to this email.
lead_confirmation_footer: You are receiving this email because you requested information about Rumi for Business.
